concept: Clustered Marionberry with Pointed Leaf
description: A berry cluster tapers downward through rounded lobes surrounding a small angular center. One pointed leaf rises diagonally from the upper right, with a straight vein running toward its tip.

concept: Marmalade Jar with Wavy Contents
description: A broad jam jar has curved shoulders beneath a thick rounded lid. Horizontal bands frame its central body, where a wavy line marks the upper surface of the contents.

concept: Square Marshmallow on Diagonal Skewer
description: A soft square marshmallow with rounded corners tilts diagonally around a thin skewer. The stick extends far toward the lower left and projects a short distance beyond the upper right edge.

concept: Cylindrical Marshmallow on Slanted Stick
description: A cylindrical marshmallow leans toward the upper right with an elliptical top and curved lower edge. A thin roasting stick enters its base and extends diagonally down toward the left.

concept: Seated Marten with Long Sweeping Tail
description: A marten sits facing right with a small rounded ear, pointed muzzle, and upright chest. Its long tail sweeps along the ground toward the right beneath the rounded haunch.

concept: Masked Bust with Crossed Eye Band
description: A front facing bust has a round head and a broad mask whose curved edges cross at the nose. A small frown sits beneath the mask above a short neck and rounded shoulders.

concept: Rounded Trunk Mark with Three Dots
description: A rounded blocklike outline has a curled lower extension resembling a short trunk. Three evenly spaced circular dots cross the upper interior, above a wide blank area within the outer contour.

concept: Eight Tooth Gear with Circular Hub
description: A gear has eight broad teeth spaced around a round body. Two centered circles define a raised hub and small axle opening, with the teeth arranged evenly around the outer edge.

concept: Open End Wrench with Rounded Handle
description: A wrench angles toward the upper right with a broad open jaw and a long narrow handle. The jaw has curved outer shoulders, while the lower handle ends in a rounded cap.

concept: Reclining Chair with Splayed Legs
description: A reclining chair has a long flat seat and an inclined backrest rising to the upper left. Two slender legs splay outward beneath its bent cushion outline at the front and rear.

concept: Pair of Plain Round Maracas
description: Two maracas sit side by side at opposing slight angles, each with a broad round head and narrow handle. The right maraca sits higher, and both handles end in rounded tips.

concept: Pentagonal House Shaped Sign on Stem
description: A plain pentagonal sign resembles a house with a pointed roof and straight lower sides. A short vertical stem descends from the center of its flat base, leaving the interior blank.

concept: Person in Deep Forward Lunge
description: A round headed person lunges toward the right with the front knee bent and the rear leg extended backward close to the ground. One bent arm reaches forward above the front thigh.

concept: Sombrero Wearing Bust with V Neck
description: A featureless oval face sits beneath a wide sombrero with a domed crown and thick rounded brim. A broad torso with a deep V neckline curves outward below the head.

concept: Person with Pointed Bandana Face Cover
description: A person faces forward with parted hair above a blank upper face. A large bandana covers the lower face and tapers to a point over the broad shoulder outline below.

concept: Person Beneath Three Rating Stars
description: A round headed bust sits below three separate five pointed stars. The middle star is larger and slightly higher than the flanking stars, which form a shallow arc over the person.

concept: Ringed Planet Beside Small Star
description: A round planet is encircled by a tilted elliptical ring crossing its lower half. A small four pointed star floats above and to the right, separate from the planet and ring.

concept: Exploration Rover with Tall Antenna
description: A rover has a boxy body above two large wheels with circular hubs. A small raised cabin sits at the left, while a tall antenna with a round tip rises near the center.

concept: Plus and Minus Divided by Diagonal Slash
description: A plus sign sits in the upper left and a horizontal minus sign occupies the lower right. A long diagonal slash separates them, rising from the lower left to the upper right.

concept: Plus Sign Above Separate Minus Bar
description: A plain plus sign sits centrally above a separate horizontal minus bar. The plus has balanced crossing arms, while the lower bar extends slightly wider and remains clearly separated below.

concept: Mammoth with Long Trunk and Curved Tusk
description: A mammoth faces left with a domed back, small eye, and curved ear mark. A long trunk descends beside a forward curving tusk, while broad legs support the heavy body.

concept: Gas Mask with Two Round Eye Lenses
description: A gas mask has a broad rounded facepiece with two circular eye lenses. A large lower respirator overlaps the facepiece, enclosing a smaller rounded opening divided by a horizontal line.

concept: Scalloped Lychee with Short Stem
description: A round lychee has a continuous scalloped outline formed by many small lobes. A short curved stem rises from the top, while the center of the fruit remains blank.

concept: Round Manhole Cover with Square Grid
description: A circular manhole cover has a broad outer rim around a smaller round interior. Straight horizontal and vertical lines cross within that interior to form an evenly spaced grid.

concept: Frowning Tree with Angular Nose
description: A tree has a broad lobed canopy above a straight trunk bearing a face. Two short upright eyes, a projecting angular nose, and a small downward curved mouth give it a sad expression.

concept: Magnifying Glass with Long Diagonal Handle
description: A large circular lens joins a straight handle at its lower right edge. The handle extends diagonally downward and right, while the lens remains empty within its uninterrupted round outline.

concept: Compact Magnifying Glass with Extended Handle
description: A round lens sits toward the upper left with a long straight handle projecting from its lower right edge. The handle continues diagonally into the lower right corner beneath the blank lens.

concept: Segmented Larva Curving Upward
description: A plump larva curves upward toward the right through several rounded body segments. Crosswise divisions separate the sections, with a rounded tail on the left and a larger rounded upper tip.

concept: Beetle with Straight Antennae and Angular Legs
description: A beetle faces upward with a rounded head, two straight antennae, and a broad oval body divided vertically. Three jointed legs project from each side in a balanced arrangement.

concept: Beetle with Curved Antennae and Legs
description: A beetle has a round head above a broad oval body split by a central seam. Curved antennae rise outward, and three pairs of bent legs spread from the body's sides.

concept: Pointed Leaf with Single Side Vein
description: A broad leaf tapers into a sharp upper tip and a narrow lower base. A straight central vein extends into the stem, with one short diagonal branch pointing upward to the right.

concept: Plain Shorts with Broad Waistband
description: A pair of shorts has a straight horizontal waistband above outward sloping sides. A narrow triangular gap separates the two legs, whose lower hems curve gently downward toward the center.

concept: Sleeveless Dress with Small Fitted Bodice
description: A sleeveless dress has a shallow rounded neckline and a small fitted bodice narrowing toward the waist. A horizontal waist seam joins a long flared skirt with a gently curved hem.

concept: Tulip with Three Sharp Petal Tips
description: A tulip blossom has a rounded bowl shaped base and three tall pointed petal tips. A straight stem descends between two broad curved leaves that meet along a flat lower edge.

concept: Standing Magpie with Long Tapered Tail
description: A magpie faces left with a pointed beak, dot eye, and upright chest. Its folded wing follows the sloping back above a long rounded tail, supported by two short angled legs.

concept: Spiral Lollipop on Upright Stick
description: A round lollipop contains a continuous inward curling spiral within its outer edge. A thin straight stick descends from the small opening at the bottom of the circular candy.

concept: Standing Mallard with Broad Folded Wing
description: A mallard faces left with an open edged bill and long curved neck. Its rounded body carries a broad folded wing tapering toward the raised tail, above two short straight legs.

concept: Surprised Face with Oval Open Mouth
description: A circular face has tiny dot eyes beneath raised curved brows. A tall oval mouth opens centrally below them, leaving a broad blank area around the simple facial features.

concept: Swimming Manatee with Rounded Flippers
description: A manatee swims toward the right with a broad rounded body, small eye, and downturned muzzle. One large flipper hangs beside the body, and a divided tail spreads at the left.

concept: Rectangular Entrance with Central Arch
description: A broad rectangular entrance surround contains a tall central arched opening. A horizontal band crosses near the top, while equal side piers descend to a straight shared lower edge.

concept: Three Horizontal Logs in Staggered Stack
description: Three long timber logs stack horizontally, with the middle log projecting farther left and right. Rounded cut ends appear on the left, while their long bodies end in broad curves on the right.

concept: Three Tall Slanted Base Bars
description: Three narrow upright bars stand separately at different heights, with the center tallest and the left shortest. Their upper edges are flat while each lower edge tilts slightly in perspective.

concept: Open Hooded Mantle with Broad Panels
description: A hooded mantle spreads outward from a round hood with an empty face opening. Two curved front panels hang apart down the body, revealing a narrow central opening and lower connecting hem.

concept: Closed Treasure Chest with Rounded Latch
description: A treasure chest has a rounded rectangular body and a domed upper section divided by two upright bands. A horizontal lid seam dips into a rounded central latch on the front.

concept: Sword Standing Inside Open Treasure Chest
description: A sword rises diagonally from an open chest, with a round pommel and curved crossguard above its broad blade. The chest has a thick rounded front rim and a small centered latch.

concept: Triangular Pennant on Footed Mast
description: A tall straight mast carries a small right pointing triangular pennant near its top. The mast continues below the flag to a short horizontal base, leaving the surrounding area empty.

concept: Macaw Profile with Large Hooked Bill
description: A macaw faces right with a domed head and a large downward hooked bill. Its long folded wing tapers toward the lower left above a narrow tail extending beneath the body.

concept: Paired Loquats Hanging Beneath Leaf
description: Two oval loquat fruits hang at different angles from a short forked stem. One long pointed leaf extends to the upper right, above the overlapping upper shoulders of the fruit.

concept: Three Unequal Upright Chart Bars
description: Three separate rectangular bars share a lower baseline and rise to different heights. The center bar is tallest, the right bar is intermediate, and the left bar is shortest.

concept: Longship with Curved Sail and Three Oars
description: A longship has a shallow curved hull with raised ends beneath a central mast. A broad sail curves inward on the left and outward on the right, with three diagonal oars below.

concept: Whole Macadamia Beside Cut Nut Half
description: A whole oval nut sits behind a cut half shown at an angle. The front half has a broad outer shell surrounding an irregular rounded kernel, with a small opening along its lower left edge.

concept: Horizontal Log with Short Angled Branch
description: A horizontal log has an oval cut face on the left and a long rounded body extending right. A short squared branch stub rises diagonally from the upper middle of the trunk.

concept: Flared Mini Skirt with Two Pleat Lines
description: A short skirt widens from a straight waistband into a broad curved hem. Two long inner pleat lines angle outward toward the bottom, framing a plain central panel between them.

concept: Ear with Deep Inner Fold and Rounded Lobe
description: An ear outline curves from a broad upper arch into a rounded lower lobe. A deep inner fold curls inward along the left side beneath a second broad curved ridge.

concept: Angry Horned Monster with Raised Arms
description: A squat monster has two curved horns above a rounded rectangular body and short spread arms. Slanted brows, small eyes, and a frown mark its face above two short outward feet.

concept: Muffin with Three Lobed Domed Top
description: A muffin has a broad domed top with rounded side lobes and a scalloped lower edge. Beneath it, a tapered paper cup narrows toward a flat base with softened corners.

concept: Rounded Lower Right Corner Line
description: A long horizontal line runs toward the right before rounding upward into a tall vertical side. The two open arms form a lower right corner around a large empty interior.

concept: Arrow Lifting Square Toward Upper Outline
description: A rounded square sits below a second square indicated only by four corner marks. A long arrow curves upward beside them on the right, ending with an open head near the upper square.

concept: Outlined Capital M
description: A large uppercase M has two upright outer stems and deep diagonal strokes meeting at the center. Its thick outlined form encloses narrow inner gaps, with a flattened lower central junction.

concept: Battlement Wall Behind Water Moat
description: A crenellated castle wall rises behind a broad rounded water enclosure. Two wavy horizontal lines cross the foreground water, while three square battlements stand evenly across the top of the wall.

concept: Lobed Bubble with Two Tiny Interior Dots
description: An irregular bubble has a small rounded left lobe joined to a larger right lobe and a shallow lower bulge. Two tiny separated dots sit inside its otherwise empty center.

concept: Round Millstone with Central Hole and Seam
description: A circular millstone has a small round center opening. A diagonal seam crosses from the lower left edge toward the upper right, interrupted by the circular opening at the middle.

concept: Round Meatball with Short Curved Marks
description: A round meatball has an uninterrupted circular outer edge and four scattered curved marks inside. The short arcs sit around the center without touching one another or the outer contour.

concept: Circular Badge Containing Text Bubble
description: A large circle surrounds a smaller rounded square speech bubble with a pointed lower left tail. Two short horizontal text lines sit inside the bubble, leaving generous space around it.

concept: Handlebar Moustache with Upturned Tips
description: A broad moustache has two matching lobes meeting at a central dip. Its lower curves meet at an inward notch, while the thin outer tips sweep upward at both ends.

concept: Music Monitor Beside Tall Speaker
description: A desktop monitor displays two joined musical notes above its lower bezel and central stand. A tall rounded speaker overlaps the screen on the right, with two circular drivers stacked vertically.

concept: Stepped Crown Molding Cross Section
description: A molding profile has a square outer corner and a narrow inset border along its top and left. The opposite edge descends through alternating straight steps and rounded concave transitions.

concept: Broad Molar with Two Rounded Roots
description: A molar has a broad crown with a shallow central dip and smoothly bulging sides. Its lower half narrows into two long rounded roots divided by a deep arched gap.

concept: Arrow Down Toward Long Baseline
description: A thin vertical arrow points downward with two short diagonal arms forming an open head. A separate long horizontal bar sits beneath the tip, leaving a clear gap between them.

concept: Two Overlapping Desktop Monitors
description: Two desktop monitors overlap diagonally, with a smaller screen higher on the left and a larger screen lower on the right. Each has a short stand, and the foreground screen has a lower bezel.

concept: Twin Wireless Routers Beneath Signal Arcs
description: Two squat routers stand side by side with tapered bodies, rounded corners, and horizontal base seams. Three centered wireless signal arcs rise above the pair, increasing in width toward the top.

concept: Moai Head with Long Angular Nose
description: A moai statue faces left with a tall blocky head, heavy brow, and long angular nose. A short horizontal mouth sits above a broad chin and a flared neck base.

concept: Toy Brick with Four Top Studs
description: A rectangular toy brick appears in perspective, showing two side faces beneath a diamond shaped top. Four circular studs occupy the top, with the rear stud rising visibly higher in the view.

concept: Four Tilted Window Panels
description: Four separate slanted panels form a two by two arrangement around a narrow cross shaped gap. Their outer corners alternate between sharp and rounded, while all panels lean toward the right.

concept: Capped Bottle with Wavy Liquid Surface
description: A glass bottle has a short narrow neck beneath a rounded cap and broad curved shoulders. A wavy liquid surface crosses the middle of its straight sided body above a rounded base.

concept: Three People Beneath Gridded Globe
description: Three round headed people form a row beneath a large globe. Curved longitude lines and straight horizontal latitude bands cross the globe, while the people's shoulder outlines meet along the bottom.

concept: Three Leaf Seedling on Low Mound
description: A seedling rises from a small curved soil mound on a straight stem. One pointed leaf stands upright at the top, while two broad pointed leaves spread outward from opposite sides.

concept: Narrow Rounded Minus Bar
description: A single long horizontal bar has parallel straight edges and fully rounded ends. Its blank narrow interior remains consistent in height across the center, with no attached marks or surrounding enclosure.

concept: Steaming Coffee Mug with Side Handle
description: A mug has a straight upper rim and a deep rounded bottom, with a curved handle attached on the right. Two separate wavy steam lines rise above the open top.

concept: Closed Lips with Wavy Mouth Line
description: A pair of lips has a shallow central dip across the upper contour and a broad curved lower lip. A gently wavy horizontal mouth line joins the pointed outer corners.

concept: Magnifying Glass Containing Footprints
description: A round magnifying lens contains two separated footprint shapes, each formed by a long oval sole and smaller heel mark. A straight handle extends diagonally downward from the lower right edge.

concept: Front Facing Man with Tilted Beret
description: A man's face sits beneath a tilted beret with a short top stem. Small ears, straight brows, dot eyes, an angular nose, and a slight smile appear within the rounded head.

concept: Wheelchair with Large Rear Wheel
description: A wheelchair faces right with a large rear wheel, small front wheel, and projecting footrest. A tall curved push handle rises above the seat and rounded armrest on the upper left.

concept: Preserve Jar with Inset Contents Panel
description: A squat jar has a broad rounded lid, narrow neck, and curved shoulders. A large inset panel fills its front, containing one small irregular piece and two tiny scattered dots.

concept: Mastodon Mark with Rounded M Interior
description: A rounded Mastodon mark has a broad upper body and a curled lower extension. A thick rounded lowercase m shape occupies the interior, with two deep narrow openings between its stems.

concept: Plain Ruler with Five Short Ticks
description: A horizontal rectangular ruler has a straight outline and five short upright tick marks spaced along its upper interior. The remaining surface is blank, with no visible numbers or labels.

concept: Castle Tower with Three Square Battlements
description: A square castle tower has three evenly spaced battlements separated by deep rectangular notches. A tall rounded arched doorway rises centrally from the flat base of the otherwise blank wall.

concept: Two Overlapping Folded Logo Panels
description: Two broad panels overlap diagonally to form an angular folded mark. Their upper edges meet in a central valley, while the forward panel slopes down to a rounded lower right corner.

concept: Crested Helmet with Round Ear Plate
description: A helmet faces left with a projecting brow, deep face opening, and flat lower edge. A large circular ear plate occupies the side beneath a broad raised crest and smaller rear tab.

concept: Oval Speech Bubble with Three Text Lines
description: A broad oval speech bubble tapers into a pointed tail at the lower left. Three horizontal text lines sit centrally inside, with the middle line extending farther than the outer two.

concept: Mimosa Branch with Berries and Pointed Leaves
description: A branching mimosa sprig carries several round berries on the left and pointed leaves on the right. Thin angled stems join the fruit and leaves to a long central branch.

concept: Arched Mine Entrance with Forward Tracks
description: A mine entrance has a broad horizontal lintel above two thick side supports and a rounded arch. Two rails spread toward the foreground, crossed by short horizontal sleepers beneath the opening.

concept: Flowing Mist Lines with Rounded Bends
description: Several separate horizontal lines stretch across the view at different heights. Three bend smoothly upward or downward near their ends, while a short straight line occupies the upper right gap.

concept: Phone with Long Outgoing Arrow
description: An upright rounded phone has a lower bezel line and an opening in its right edge. A long horizontal arrow crosses the opening and points right with an open angled head.

concept: Phone with Short Outgoing Arrow
description: A tall rounded phone has a horizontal lower bezel and a gap in the right side. A separate arrow begins inside the screen and extends through the gap toward the right.

concept: Overlapping Timber Joint Diagram
description: A narrow horizontal timber enters a taller upright timber from the left. Straight rectangular outlines overlap at their intersection, revealing the inserted end within the width of the vertical member.

concept: Tapered Mosquito Net Beneath Broad Canopy
description: A mosquito net has a broad flared canopy above a tapered lower enclosure. Three upright internal lines crossed by a horizontal line suggest the mesh structure inside the hanging sides.

concept: Motorboat with Small Sloping Cabin
description: A motorboat faces right with a long sloping upper hull edge and a deeply curved bow. A small cabin with a flat roof and angled front rises above the middle of the hull.

concept: Three Overlapping Mozzarella Slices
description: Three rounded mozzarella slices overlap in a diagonal stack, with the nearest slice lower and farther left. Their smooth blank faces and curved edges create a layered arrangement without interior marks.

concept: Mud Splash with Two Small Puddles
description: A large irregular mud splash spreads into several rounded lobes around a broad center. Two detached puddles sit below it, one uneven on the left and one oval on the right.

concept: Drum Kit with Two Raised Cymbals
description: A large round bass drum sits beneath two small tilted drums. Two tall cymbal stands flank the kit, each bending outward to a slanted cymbal and ending in short splayed feet.

concept: Pair of Rounded House Slippers
description: Two slippers sit upright side by side with long rounded outlines. A curved seam crosses each slipper near the middle, separating the covered toe area from the lower foot opening.

concept: Escalator Rider Beside Direction Arrow
description: A person rides an escalator that slopes upward toward the right, with the upper body visible above its rounded side rail. A separate horizontal right pointing arrow sits below the raised end.

concept: Mortar Bowl with Diagonal Pestle
description: A deep rounded mortar bowl rests on a short flared base beneath a straight rim. A long rounded pestle rises diagonally from inside the bowl toward the upper right.

concept: Tall Pointed Quartz Crystal
description: A quartz crystal stands upright with a pointed pyramidal top and long angular sides. Straight facet edges divide the upper tip and body, tapering toward an uneven pointed lower end.

concept: Pie Chart Behind Letter P Badge
description: A large circle is divided by two radii into a visible upper right quarter. A rounded square badge overlaps its left side and contains a single upright capital P.

concept: Oven Mitt with Wide Wrist Cuff
description: An oven mitt stands upright with a broad rounded finger section and a smaller thumb projecting left. A horizontal seam separates the hand portion from a wide rounded wrist cuff.

concept: Push Mower with Raised Rear Handle
description: A lawn mower faces left with two round wheels beneath a low curved body and small raised motor housing. A long handle angles upward to the right and bends horizontally at the top.

concept: Cratered Moon Rising Behind Curved Horizon
description: A large round moon rises behind a low curved horizon crossing its lower edge. Three circular craters of different sizes dot the visible face, spaced across the upper and middle portions.

concept: Rounded Horizontal Subtraction Mark
description: A long narrow subtraction mark spans horizontally with a blank interior between two parallel edges. Semicircular end caps close both sides, producing a simple balanced bar without any surrounding shape.

concept: Empty Square with Broad Rounded Corners
description: An empty square frame has straight upright sides and horizontal top and bottom edges. Broad rounded corners join the sides smoothly around a completely blank central opening with balanced margins.

concept: Rounded Message Card with Three Lines
description: A wide rounded rectangular card contains three short horizontal lines aligned along the left. The upper two lines have matching lengths, while the lower line ends earlier toward the center.

concept: Side View Sedan with Divided Windows
description: A sedan faces right with two round wheels beneath a long body and gently rounded hood. Its raised cabin has sloping ends and a central upright divider between the two side windows.
